card: A live core turn queues behind a 15-minute judge: admit by lane, deadline at enqueue
tests_added: crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/admission.rs::tests (7 unit tests: lane table, clamp, free slot no wait, batch never takes reserve, live overflows to shared, expiry and release, whole-budget timeout)
guard_cases: existing global_semaphore_caps_live_processes (max_live_processes=1 still serialises; reserve clamps to 0)
deviations_from_card: Red-before was a compile failure (new config key, Fleet admission accessor, LedgerRow::queue_ms), so tests and implementation landed in one commit. Acceptance cases assert ordering (which fake process had started/finished, admission waiting count) instead of wall-clock upper bounds (<900 ms / <600 ms); only lower bounds (>=1200 ms, queue_ms >= 250) are timed. Admission is done in Fleet::complete around CliRunner::run (run_once no longer acquires itself), so the one-shot runner seam stays unchanged and receives the remaining budget as req.timeout_ms. ClaudeCli::new now takes an Admission instead of max_live (engine-internal callers only). ClaudeWarmSession::open takes a deadline; open_session stops on a queue Timeout instead of trying the next account. Queue time is NOT console-visible: the console reads the ledger row type in shadowrunr-types, which is outside this write set (ledger.rs is 152 lines; the card's ledger.rs:497-523 cite does not exist).
notes: cargo fmt --all -- --check is red only on sibling in-flight files (crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/preflight.rs, daemon/tests/cli.rs, sim calibration.rs/situations.rs/tournament.rs); the engine crate is fmt-clean. The API rung is not bounded by the enqueue deadline (it spawns no process); the deadline covers CLI accounts, warm spawns/turns and alt CLIs. With defaults (6 total, 2 reserved) batch work now gets at most 4 concurrent processes. shadowrunr.example.toml does not yet document live_reserved_processes (out of write set).
